annotations.title: List AWS resources of a type (paginated)

description: List resources of a given type via Cloud Control API, paginated. Returns an array of {identifier, properties}, a `nextToken` (null when exhausted), and `hasMore`. Some types need parent identifiers (e.g. nested resources under a cluster); pass those as `resourceModel`.

nextToken.description: Resume cursor from the previous call's `nextToken`. Omit for the first page.

profile.description: Override session profile for this call.

region.description: Override session region for this call.

resourceModel.description: Parent identifier properties for nested types, e.g. {ClusterArn: '...'}.

name: aws_resource_list
